name: B10-0066/2026 (The Left) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks the Central African Republic to make sure Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese aid worker held since May 2024, can use all his legal options, see his lawyers privately, and get proper medical care. It also asks for his ten-year forced labour sentence to be cancelled or changed, and for an independent investigation into claims he was tortured.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks and condemns; it cannot change the sentence.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, his lawyers and family, and the Central African authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union institutions, member states and Central African authorities.
